title: FULL SECURITY & FINANCIAL INTEGRITY AUDIT

g1_authentication_security.summary: Password hashing uses Argon2id; login flow applies rate limiting and invalid credential handling without revealing account existence. Token rotation and session handling are present in the auth service and related modules.

g2_authorization_and_idor.summary: Services check ownership (userId/accountId ownership) before mutation/read access; no explicit IDOR exploit was found in the audited code paths.

g3_input_validation.summary: DTO validation is fail-closed for malformed numeric values, negative/zero/decimal inputs, and invalid enums in the transaction write path.

g4_financial_security.summary: Financial operations continue to operate on integer cents and maintain balance invariants in the tested modules. The transaction invariant suite confirms balance arithmetic remains consistent.

g5_database_integrity.summary: The schema and repository patterns enforce key relationships and integrity safeguards in the audited modules; no destructive migration was performed. Full real Postgres-backed integration remains environment-dependent.

g6_api_security.summary: Authentication and validation guards are present, but a full API abuse/threat test run against production-like rate limiting, request-size, and CORS policy remains environment-dependent.

g7_logging_observability_security.summary: The project avoids logging raw passwords, JWTs, refresh tokens, or sensitive request bodies; structured logs keep request correlation metadata without secret leakage.

g8_audit_log_integrity.summary: Audit events include actor, action, target, time, and correlation metadata; sensitive fields are not included in the audited record format.

g9_transaction_concurrency.summary: The transactional flow includes idempotent dedupe and balance recalculation within the audited service operations. Full concurrency validation beyond unit/integration coverage remains environment-dependent.

g10_idempotency.summary: Reference-number/idempotency replay protection is present for the transaction write path and returns the same result for duplicates in the audited service behavior.

g11_abuse_rate_limiting.summary: Login and auth flows include rate-limit patterns and failure counters, but full abuse simulation and production-like rate limit tuning are not fully validated here.

g12_security_headers_cors.summary: Security header patterns are likely present at app config level, but a full production-like CORS/security-header verification was not executed in this local environment.

g13_secrets_configuration.summary: No obvious hardcoded credentials or live secrets were found in the inspected auth/config modules; no secret values were printed in outputs.

g14_dependency_security.summary: npm audit reports a high-severity vulnerability in @nestjs/swagger caused by js-yaml in the transitive dependency tree. The issue remains unresolved in the current project dependency state and requires an explicit security/compatibility review before production use.

g15_security_regression_tests.summary: Existing auth, transaction, and audit tests pass; the current codebase includes regression protection around transaction amount validation and anomaly handling. No dedicated full security regression suite covering all API abuse vectors was present in the repo.

g16_financial_invariant_testing.summary: Balance arithmetic and integer-cent invariants were validated via the transaction invariant tests. The model remains consistent for the audited financial flows.

g17_historical_recovery_boundary.summary: Historical recovery remains externally blocked, no production mutation was performed, and the boundary remains intentionally preserved as FINAL_HOLD / EXTERNAL_INFRA_DEPENDENCY.

g18_testing.summary: Relevant backend tests and TypeScript validation were executed successfully; full real Postgres-backed transfer integration remains environment-blocked and is tracked as such.

g19_phase_g_artifact.summary: This artifact was written to the non-recovery evidence area and records the audit findings and blockers.

security_findings.finding: @nestjs/swagger pulls a vulnerable js-yaml transitively in the current backend dependency tree.

financial_integrity_findings.finding: The app uses integer minor-unit values and rejects malformed and decimal monetary input in the transaction write path.
